STREET BONDS
Design and construct street and streetscape
improvements in order to implement the Fourth Street
Corridor Plan.
Fourth Street Corridor
Improvements
$500,000
Acquire land, design and rebuild public infrastructure to
include, but not necessarily be limited to:  sidewalks,
utility hookups, lighting, and streetscapes.
West Central MRA Project
$1,000,000
Plan, design and construct improvements to Lead and
Coal Avenues.
Reconstruction of Lead and
Coal Avenues - Council District
6

Plan, design and construct improvements to Lead and
Coal Avenues.
Reconstruction of Lead and
Coal Avenues
$2,000,000
Plan, design, purchase right-of-way, reconstruct and
otherwise improve major streets and purchase related
equipment where the on-going pavement management
program indicates a high priority need.  The typical cost
per project ranges from $2 million to $6 million and
general obligation bond funds are typically combined
with other fund sources.  COUNCIL AMENDMENT:
The Project Description attached hereto is expanded by
adding the following:  Subprojects identified under this
activity include Wyoming Blvd., Academy to Paseo del
Norte; and Alameda Boulevard, Edith to I-25.
Reconstruction Major Streets
$1,500,000
Plan, design, purchase right-of-way, reconstruct and
otherwise improve major intersection and purchase
related equipment including planning/managing
hardware, software and associated technical
documents.  Typical project costs ranges from $500
thousand to $1 million and general obligation bond
funds are typically combined with other fund sources.

text_excerpts.4:
STREET BONDS
Plan, design, replace, expand, construct and purchase
related equipment for the central computer control
system to interconnect all signalized intersections.  This
project may include but not necessarily be limited to
equipment purchases, design, construction of the
interconnections, upgrade of existing signals, and
emergency vehicle pre-emption systems.  The work will
be phased throughout the entire period of the Decade
Plan and the general obligation bond funds will leverage
federal funds.
Albuquerque Traffic
Management System
$400,000
Replace equipment involved with street sweeping for
AQ and NPDES issues, unpaved road maintenance
included surfacing of dirt roads and repairs due to storm
and shoulder maintenance, concrete repairs including
request for installation of ADA facilities, pavement
maintenance including pothole repairs and preparation
work for contract maintenance.
Replace Street Maintenance
Heavy Equipment
$500,000
Plan, design, and construct improvements to Atrisco
Drive, SW, between Five-Points Road and Central
Avenue.
Atrisco Drive, SW
$600,000
Design, right-of-way acquisition, material purchases and
construction of neighborhood traffic calming
improvements approved in conjunction with the city's
Neighborhood Traffic Management Program.
Neighborhood Traffic
Improvements
$250,000
Design, renovate, equip and upgrade existing medians.
Median Renovation & Water
Conservation
$500,000
Design and construction of landscaping and aesthetic
improvements on city streets and interstate facilities.
This project is anticipated to be phased over a number
of years.
Median Landscaping &
Interstate Enhancements
$2,975,000
Design and construction of median landscaping and
aesthetic improvements on Wyoming Blvd.
Medians:  Wyoming, Paseo del

$750,000

Design, installation, replacement, repair and

and infill, and streetlight infill.
